description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3: visit 1.6.4, Beta, Alpha, Infdev and the Cave game as dimensions in one world

mods.name: Retro Eras
mods.description: Visit dimensions that recreate Minecraft's historical eras with their own terrain, textures, sounds and rules: 1.6.4, Beta 1.7.3, Alpha 1.2.6, Infdev, Classic 0.30 and the first Cave game build, with the old Nether of 1.6.4, Beta and Alpha. Old textures and sounds are read from your own copies of those versions.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **1.6.4's chests, beds and signs.** Normal, trapped, ender and Christmas chests and beds use 1.6.4's textures, and signs are old in every era that had them.
- **Compass and clock.** Old in every era that had them. In Alpha and Beta each frame is drawn by a port of the code that drew them.
- **Map and potion icons.** Old map backgrounds and markers in Beta and 1.6.4, and old potion icons in 1.6.4.
- **Held items and stairs.** Items sit where they did before 1.9, with tools turned the old way round. Stairs stay straight before 1.6.4.
- **1.6.4's water, lava and horses.** Its own water and lava, and its 128 by 128 model for horses, donkeys, mules and foals. Their knees do not bend, and saddles and horse armour are still 26.3's.
- **1.6.4's villagers.** Its trade tables, with one trade to start and another each time the newest is used, no levels or experience, and no sleeping, job blocks or gossip. The old village logic is not ported, so they do not go indoors at night or breed, and no iron golems come from them.
- **Old mob behaviour.** Before 1.6.4 mobs keep 26.3's pathfinding but lose what the old games could not do: animals are not tempted, bred or led, and monsters only want players and notice you from 16 blocks.
- **Pause menu and F3.** The old pause menu layout and F3 screen in every era, and 1.6.4's own inventory screen.

Worlds you have already explored keep their old chunks and villagers, so a new world shows this best.

## Installing

1. Install [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer).
2. Put the **retroeras** jar from this release and [Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions?g=26.3) in your Fabric profile's `mods` folder.
3. In the Minecraft Launcher, play each old version once: **1.6.4**, **Beta 1.7.3**, **Alpha 1.2.6**, **Infdev 20100618**, **Classic c0.30_01c** and **rd-132211** (turn on "Historical versions" under Installations). The mod reads its old textures and sounds from those, so it never ships Mojang's files. An era whose version you have not played keeps modern textures.

## Getting to the eras

Build a nether-portal-shaped frame (at least 4 wide and 5 tall) and light it with flint and steel:

| Frame | Era |
| --- | --- |
| Stone bricks | Old Release (1.6.4) |
| Mossy cobblestone | Beta 1.7.3 |
| Pumpkins | Alpha 1.2.6 |
| Bricks | Pre-Alpha (Infdev) |
| Sponge | Classic (0.30) |
| Cobblestone | Cave game (rd-132211) |

Or dig down: the lowest bedrock layer can be mined with a diamond pickaxe, and below it is the next older era. Press **R** in an era to change its fog.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **Flat dropped items.** Before 1.6.4, dropped items are flat pictures that always face you, with up to four for a big stack. Blocks stay small spinning cubes.
- **Old mob models.** Cows lose 26.3's muzzle and get their old horns and udder. Babies are the adult with a half-size body and a big head, wearing the adult's texture.
- **Old boats, arrows and minecarts.** Boats are the plain box with no paddles, and arrows and minecarts have their old textures.
- **Old stars.** About twice today's size before 1.6.4.
- **Cave game and Classic lighting.** A block is lit or in one fixed shade, with a hard edge.
- **Old armour.** Before 1.0, armour softens falls, fire and drowning too.
- **Old recipes.** Old amounts for slabs, signs, doors and ladders, and the old recipes for fences, books, golden apples, wool and glowstone.
- **Fixed:** falling into the next era could occasionally lose its soft landing.

- **Beta's and Alpha's own decoration.** Beta 1.7.3 and Alpha 1.2.6 now decorate their worlds with ports of their own code instead of modern feature lists: lakes, dungeons with their old loot, clay, ores, Beta's old trees, flowers, tall grass, reeds, cacti, springs and snow. Alpha keeps its plainer list and its one kind of tree per chunk. Wild pumpkins have their faces again.

Only newly generated chunks change. Parts of a Beta or Alpha world you have already explored stay as they were.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- **1.6.4's End.** A stronghold's End portal now leads to a port of 1.6.4's End: one island, obsidian pillars with burning crystals, and 1.6.4's own dragon AI, damage rules and death. The exit portal plays the credits and returns you to the era.
- **Each era's own achievements.** 1.6.4 and Beta have their old achievements, earned the old way, and 26.3's advancements are not earned in the eras.
- **1.6.4 villagers** wear their old job outfits.
- **Old rules:** no rain in Alpha, no XP before 1.8, instant bows, old armour values and stack sizes, no swimming or crawling, witch huts in 1.6.4, and Classic's liquids.
- **More old textures:** particles, buttons, armour, paintings and leftover icons.
